params.reason: Test test_no_retry_on_non_telegram_error FAILS: When python-telegram-bot is not installed, telegram_notifier.py line 31 sets TelegramError = Exception as fallback. This causes ALL exceptions (including ValueError) to be treated as retryable by the @retry_sync(retryable_exceptions=(TelegramError,)) decorator, and the isinstance(e, TelegramError) check inside all 6 functions always returns True, re-raising every exception. The fix: change the fallback to a sentinel exception class (e.g., class _TelegramNotAvailable(Exception): pass) so non-Telegram exceptions are NOT caught by the retry decorator and NOT re-raised inside the functions. Also, 25 email tests from T02 are skipped because aiosmtplib is not installed, but that is an environment issue, not a code bug.
